title: Misty Terrain

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Aura Sphere, Clear Smog, Doom Desire, Hydro Steam, Icy Wind, Magical Leaf, Mist Ball, Moongeist Beam, Mystical Fire, Silver Wind, Smog, Springtide Storm, Steam Eruption, and Strange Steam: 1.5× stronger.
Dark Pulse, Night Daze, and Shadow Ball: halved (0.5×).
Explosion, Mind Blown, and Self-Destruct: no effect here.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Fairy-type.
Secret Power can lower the target's Special Attack.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Acid Downpour, Clear Smog, Corrosive Gas, Poison Gas, and Smog change the field into Corrosive Mist once their uses add up to 2 (Acid Downpour 2, Clear Smog 1, Corrosive Gas 1, Poison Gas 1, and Smog 1). The old field returns when the new one ends or is removed.
Bleakwind Storm, Defog, Gust, Hurricane, Razor Wind, Supersonic Skystrike, Tailwind, Twister, and Whirlwind break the field apart, exposing whatever lay beneath it.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Water Compaction: Defense +2 when it enters.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Dry Skin restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Special Defense +1 and receives a Wish.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
